items.title: Route `/deepwiki/:projectId` renders the wiki browser
acceptance: GIVEN an authenticated user who may read the project's wikis
WHEN the browser navigates to the DeepWiki route for that project
THEN the wiki browser is displayed at that URL
AND a user without the read permission is refused rather than shown an empty page

items.title: The wiki list is loaded from the project's artifact bucket
acceptance: GIVEN a project with at least one generated wiki
WHEN the wiki browser opens
THEN every generated wiki for that project is listed
AND a project with no wikis shows an empty state rather than an error

items.title: A wiki page's markdown is fetched and rendered
acceptance: GIVEN a wiki with at least one page
WHEN a page is selected in the navigation
THEN that page's markdown is fetched and rendered
AND a page whose content cannot be fetched reports that instead of rendering blank

items.title: Wiki artifacts are read over the legacy runtime's artifact routes
acceptance: GIVEN a wiki whose pages are stored as artifacts
WHEN the browser requests a page
THEN the request goes to /api/v2/artifacts/artifact/default/{projectId}/{bucket}/{name}
AND the artifact body is returned

waiver.reason: elitea-main serves no such route. The path family /api/v2/artifacts/artifact(s)/default/... exists only in the legacy runtime, so on the standalone Go stack these fifteen call sites answer 404. Reproducing them natively would port a defect. See parity/notes/deepwiki-artifact-store.md for the proof.
waiver.replacesBehaviour: The native feature reads and writes through /api/v2/artifacts/objects/{projectID}/{bucket}[/{key}], which elitea-main does serve and which v2.yaml already declares.

items.title: Wiki generation streams progress and can be stopped
acceptance: GIVEN a project with a configured repository
WHEN generation is started
THEN progress is shown as the provider reports it
AND stopping generation ends the run and leaves the previous wiki readable

items.title: Generation state survives a page reload
acceptance: GIVEN a generation run in progress
WHEN the page is reloaded
THEN the run is still shown as in progress
AND a run that finished while the page was closed is not shown as running

items.title: A mermaid diagram that fails to render offers a quick fix
acceptance: GIVEN a wiki page containing a mermaid block that fails to render
WHEN the quick fix is requested
THEN a corrected block is proposed and can be accepted or rejected
AND accepting replaces only that block, leaving the rest of the page unchanged

items.title: An accepted quick fix can be undone
acceptance: GIVEN a quick fix that has been accepted
WHEN undo is requested
THEN the page returns to its content before the fix
AND the diagram's original error is shown again

items.title: Edited page markdown is saved back to the wiki
acceptance: GIVEN a wiki page open in the editor
WHEN the edited markdown is saved
THEN the stored page reflects the edit on the next read
AND a failed save reports the failure rather than closing the editor as if it had worked

items.title: Toolkit settings are edited and saved
acceptance: GIVEN a project whose DeepWiki toolkit is configured
WHEN a setting is changed and saved
THEN the new value is used by the next generation run
AND an invalid value is refused with the reason shown against the field

items.title: A wiki and its artifacts can be deleted
acceptance: GIVEN a generated wiki
WHEN deletion is confirmed
THEN the wiki stops being listed and its stored pages are removed
AND a partial failure reports which artifacts remain rather than claiming success

items.title: The wiki chat answers questions about the generated wiki
acceptance: GIVEN a generated wiki
WHEN a question is asked in the wiki chat
THEN the answer streams into the conversation
AND an interrupted stream leaves the partial answer visible rather than discarding it
